  <script>
    function switchChipStrategy(containerId, strategyId) {
      // Get the container
      const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
      if (!container) return;
      
      // Find all selector elements within this container using the specific class
      const selectors = container.querySelectorAll('.strategy-selector-' + containerId);
      
      // Hide all strategy content divs within this container
      const strategyContents = container.querySelectorAll('.strategy-content');
      strategyContents.forEach(function(content) {
        content.style.display = 'none';
      });
      
      // Show the selected strategy content
      const selectedStrategy = document.getElementById('strategy-' + strategyId);
      if (selectedStrategy) {
        selectedStrategy.style.display = 'block';
        
        // Update the selector value for all selectors in this container
        selectors.forEach(function(selectElement) {
          if (selectElement) {
            selectElement.value = strategyId;
          }
        });
      }
    }
  </script>

// The global per-page selection keeps the separate mobile and desktop banners in sync.
(function() {
  const messages = ["Win at UCL Fantasy with our new all-in-one toolkit.","Find better UCL Fantasy picks with projected points and domestic data.","Build Smarter Squads with the UCL Draft Tool","Rate your UCL Fantasy Draft"];
  const noticeKey = 'ffs_notice_ucl_toolkit_2026_v1';
  if (!Array.isArray(messages) || !messages.length) return;

  window.FFS = window.FFS || {};
  window.FFS.noticeMessageSelections = window.FFS.noticeMessageSelections || {};

  let selectedMessage = window.FFS.noticeMessageSelections[noticeKey];
  if (messages.indexOf(selectedMessage) === -1) {
    selectedMessage = messages[Math.floor(Math.random() * messages.length)];
    window.FFS.noticeMessageSelections[noticeKey] = selectedMessage;
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.notice-banner-message').forEach(function(element) {
    if (element.getAttribute('data-notice-key') !== noticeKey) return;
    element.textContent = selectedMessage;
    if (!element.classList.contains('is-message-ready')) {
      element.classList.add('is-message-ready');
    }
  });
})();

    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

  function handleDrawerClose() {
    document.body.classList.remove('drawer-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  const drawer = document.getElementById('drawer-right-sidebar');
  if (drawer) {
    const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
      mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
        if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
          const isOpen = !drawer.classList.contains('translate-x-full');
          if (isOpen) {
            handleDrawerOpen();
          } else {
            handleDrawerClose();
          }
        }
      });
    });

    observer.observe(drawer, {
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ['class']
    });

    document.addEventListener('drawer:show', function(event) {
      if (event.target.id === 'drawer-right-sidebar') {
        handleDrawerOpen();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('drawer:hide', function(event) {
      if (event.target.id === 'drawer-right-sidebar') {
        handleDrawerClose();
      }
    });
  }
});

  let selectedMessage = window.FFS.noticeMessageSelections[noticeKey];
  if (messages.indexOf(selectedMessage) === -1) {

    window.FFS.noticeMessageSelections[noticeKey] = selectedMessage;

  document.querySelectorAll('.notice-banner-message').forEach(function(element) {
    if (element.getAttribute('data-notice-key') !== noticeKey) return;
    element.textContent = selectedMessage;
    if (!element.classList.contains('is-message-ready')) {

      <script>
        (function() {
          // Only add the initialization code once
          if (window.fplPriceChangesInitialized) return;
          window.fplPriceChangesInitialized = true;

          function initPriceChangesWidget(container) {
            const rows = container.getElementsByClassName('price-changes-row');
            const buttons = container.getElementsByTagName('button');
            const pagination = container.querySelector('.price-changes-pagination');
            
            // Skip if already initialized
            if (container.dataset.initialized) return;
            container.dataset.initialized = 'true';

            function showPage(pageNum) {
              const start = (pageNum - 1) * 10;
              const end = start + 10;

              Array.from(rows).forEach(row => {
                row.classList.remove('active');
              });

              Array.from(rows).slice(start, end).forEach(row => {
                row.classList.add('active');
              });

              Array.from(buttons).forEach(button => {
                button.classList.remove('current');
                if (parseInt(button.dataset.page) === pageNum) {
                  button.classList.add('current');
                }
              });
            }

            // Remove any existing listener before adding new one
            if (pagination._clickHandler) {
              pagination.removeEventListener('click', pagination._clickHandler);
            }

            // Store the handler reference for potential cleanup
            pagination._clickHandler = function(e) {
              if (e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON') {
                e.preventDefault();
                showPage(parseInt(e.target.dataset.page));
              }
            };

            pagination.addEventListener('click', pagination._clickHandler);
          }

          function initAllWidgets() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.awsm-fpl-price-changes-widget').forEach(widget => {
              initPriceChangesWidget(widget);
            });
          }

          // Try to initialize multiple times with increasing delays
          const initializationAttempts = [1000, 3000, 5000];
          initializationAttempts.forEach(delay => {
            setTimeout(initAllWidgets, delay);
          });

          // Watch for new widgets being added
          const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            let shouldInit = false;
            mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
              if (mutation.type === 'childList') {
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach(function(node) {
                  if (node.nodeType === 1) {
                    if (node.matches('.awsm-fpl-price-changes-widget') || 
                        node.querySelector('.awsm-fpl-price-changes-widget')) {
                      shouldInit = true;
                    }
                  }
                });
              } else if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && 
                        mutation.target.matches('.awsm-fpl-price-changes-widget')) {
                shouldInit = true;
              }
            });
            if (shouldInit) {
              initAllWidgets();
            }
          });

          observer.observe(document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['class']
          });
        })();
      </script>

  <script>
    function switchChipStrategy(containerId, strategyId) {
      // Get the container
      const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
      if (!container) return;
      
      // Find all selector elements within this container using the specific class
      const selectors = container.querySelectorAll('.strategy-selector-' + containerId);
      
      // Hide all strategy content divs within this container
      const strategyContents = container.querySelectorAll('.strategy-content');
      strategyContents.forEach(function(content) {
        content.style.display = 'none';
      });
      
      // Show the selected strategy content
      const selectedStrategy = document.getElementById('strategy-' + strategyId);
      if (selectedStrategy) {
        selectedStrategy.style.display = 'block';
        
        // Update the selector value for all selectors in this container
        selectors.forEach(function(selectElement) {
          if (selectElement) {
            selectElement.value = strategyId;
          }
        });
      }
    }

  if (drawer) {
    const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
      mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
        if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
          const isOpen = !drawer.classList.contains('translate-x-full');
          if (isOpen) {
            handleDrawerOpen();
          } else {
            handleDrawerClose();
          }
        }
      });
    });

    observer.observe(drawer, {
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ['class']
    });

    document.addEventListener('drawer:show', function(event) {
      if (event.target.id === 'drawer-right-sidebar') {
        handleDrawerOpen();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('drawer:hide', function(event) {
      if (event.target.id === 'drawer-right-sidebar') {

      }
    });
  }

      <script>
        (function() {
          // Only add the initialization code once
          if (window.fplPriceChangesInitialized) return;
          window.fplPriceChangesInitialized = true;

          function initPriceChangesWidget(container) {
            const rows = container.getElementsByClassName('price-changes-row');
            const buttons = container.getElementsByTagName('button');
            const pagination = container.querySelector('.price-changes-pagination');
            
            // Skip if already initialized
            if (container.dataset.initialized) return;
            container.dataset.initialized = 'true';

            function showPage(pageNum) {
              const start = (pageNum - 1) * 10;
              const end = start + 10;

              Array.from(rows).forEach(row => {
                row.classList.remove('active');
              });

              Array.from(rows).slice(start, end).forEach(row => {
                row.classList.add('active');
              });

              Array.from(buttons).forEach(button => {
                button.classList.remove('current');
                if (parseInt(button.dataset.page) === pageNum) {
                  button.classList.add('current');
                }
              });
            }

            // Remove any existing listener before adding new one
            if (pagination._clickHandler) {
              pagination.removeEventListener('click', pagination._clickHandler);
            }

            // Store the handler reference for potential cleanup
            pagination._clickHandler = function(e) {
              if (e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON') {
                e.preventDefault();
                showPage(parseInt(e.target.dataset.page));
              }
            };

            pagination.addEventListener('click', pagination._clickHandler);
          }

          function initAllWidgets() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.awsm-fpl-price-changes-widget').forEach(widget => {
              initPriceChangesWidget(widget);
            });
          }

          // Try to initialize multiple times with increasing delays
          const initializationAttempts = [1000, 3000, 5000];
          initializationAttempts.forEach(delay => {
            setTimeout(initAllWidgets, delay);
          });

          // Watch for new widgets being added
          const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            let shouldInit = false;
            mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
              if (mutation.type === 'childList') {
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach(function(node) {
                  if (node.nodeType === 1) {
                    if (node.matches('.awsm-fpl-price-changes-widget') || 
                        node.querySelector('.awsm-fpl-price-changes-widget')) {
                      shouldInit = true;
                    }
                  }
                });
              } else if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && 
                        mutation.target.matches('.awsm-fpl-price-changes-widget')) {
                shouldInit = true;
              }
            });
            if (shouldInit) {
              initAllWidgets();
            }
          });

          observer.observe(document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['class']
          });
        })();
      </script>
